Anika: Quick sync — proposing a new benchmark protocol for long-context, context-mix workloads. Goal: repeatable comparisons between replay harness and synthetic generator, and clearer signal for kernel selection + batching heuristics. Draft below, pls skim. @Lee @Miguel :eyes:
Lee: Looks sensible. Q: how do we define/measure KV warmup vs cold-start? Need deterministic cache state across runs.
Miguel: Could define 'warm' as when cache hit rate stabilizes within 2% over a 30s window. That maps to realistic prefix reuse.
Anika: Proposal: each experiment has 3 phases: cold (clean VM, empty KV), warmup (replay/synth until hit-rate plateau), measurement (fixed-duration capture). For synthetic runs we emulate prefix reuse using a prefix-pool with controlled reuse probability. Capture kernel-selection traces and batch composition.
Sam: @Anika are we capturing per-step kernel decisions? perf-bot emits selection logs but we need seq-len + batch-size context per decision.
perf-bot: auto-report from recent smoke: run_id=jr-210110-9 avg_latency=42ms kernel_usage={nvfused_matmul_v2:60, matmul_ref:40} trace_id=abc123 :robot_face:
Priya: Also add a "batch-shaping" knob: target_batch_util + max_wait_ms. And sweep seq-len distributions: heavy-tail, uniform, bimodal. Those affect when batcher yields vs waits.
AJ: KV eviction in multi-user sim is important. Tag requests with user_id hash and simulate realistic churn so eviction patterns match production.
Anika: Metrics to export: p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/s, kernel-switch-rate, cache-hit-rate, avg batch size, tail under cache-hot/cold, and regression delta vs baseline. Export traces to perfdb for cross-correlation.
Lee: Quick run commands to standardize:
```
# replay harness
./harness/run_load --config configs/long_ctx_mixed.yaml \  --mode=measurement --trace-kernel --emit-batches --outdir /perf/artifacts/$RUN_ID

# synthetic generator
./harness/run_synth --profile configs/synth_prefix_pool.json \  --seq-skew heavy_tail --seed 42 --emit-kernel-traces
```
Miguel: Please upload profiler artifacts (flamegraphs, nvprof) per kernel. Put under /perf/artifacts/<run-id> with metadata.json describing seed/config.
Sam: did a short smoke. Observed a regression when batcher waited 12ms -> bumped fallback rate. Snippet from node logs:
```
[WARN] batch_wait=12ms -> batch_size=1 -> kernel=fallback_matmul
[INFO] seq_len=8192 kv_hit_rate=0.20 user_tag=0x7a9c
```
Priya: :thumbsup: Let's AB test old batching heuristic vs "burst-aware" heuristic. Keep all other variables identical, run 5 seeds each, compare median + p95 deltas.
Anika: Plan: schedule jobs tomorrow early, 5 seeds each, gather perfdb artifacts, then run automated regression checks that flag >5% p95 delta or kernel-switch-rate increases >10%. I'll post links when runs complete. Thanks all.
